headline: Growth accelerates as margins and profit hit fresh records
summary_short: Total revenue grew 14% y/y to €4.78 billion in Q2 2026, gross margin hit a record 33.4% (+193bps y/y), and operating income rose 61% y/y to €655 million.
summary_long: Premium revenue rose 15% y/y on subscriber growth (300M, +9%) and ARPU gains (+7% to €4.89), while Ad-Supported revenue grew 1% y/y. Gross margin hit a record 33.4% (+193bps y/y) as revenue growth outpaced content costs. Operating income rose 61% y/y to €655 million despite higher marketing and cloud/AI spend. Net income swung to €545 million from a €86 million loss; diluted EPS was €2.61 versus €(0.42). Free cash flow was €797 million, +14% y/y, with €9.4 billion in cash, restricted cash and short-term investments. Q3 2026 guidance: €5.0 billion revenue, 32.9% gross margin, €670 million operating income.

drivers.explanation: Management said Q2 was led by strength in Subscribers and profitability: revenue came in-line with guidance while gross margin, operating income, and subscriber adds all beat guidance.
Premium revenue grew 15% y/y (16% constant-currency) on subscriber and ARPU gains; Ad-Supported grew 1% y/y (3% constant-currency); unfavorable FX slowed total revenue growth by ~70bps.
Premium gains came from revenue growth outpacing music, audiobook and video-podcast costs; Ad-Supported gains came from favorable podcast mix and a digital-services-tax repeal.
Reflects gross-margin strength plus higher opex from temporary investments in marketing and cloud/AI spend; Social Charges came in €9 million below forecast on share-price movement.
Margin expansion is fully explained by operating income growing faster (+61% y/y) than revenue (+14% y/y).
Driven by higher operating income (+61% y/y) plus a swing in finance income/(costs) to a net €65 million gain from a €(358) million net cost a year earlier, per the financial statements.
EPS improvement tracks the net income swing to €545 million from a €(86) million loss, on a similar diluted share count (~209 million shares).
€797 million in Q2, +14% y/y, lifting trailing-twelve-month Free Cash Flow to €3.3 billion.
Grew 9% y/y to 300 million on 7 million net adds in the quarter versus guidance of 6 million, with growth across all regions.
Grew 12% y/y to 777 million on 16 million net additions, slightly below guidance of 17 million, with growth across all regions.
